title: E5 physical acquisition extension: 8 receiver configurations, reference-decision and separate truth evaluation

settings.objective_note: g(S)=logdet(J_stack(old + candidates(S)) + 0.1*I3), exact shared-map criterion; no forward/adjoint is required for triple scoring after each candidate tangent block is precomputed
settings.reference_state_note: alpha=clip(0.2+0.05*N(0,1),[-0.5,0.5]), x=clip(0.02*N(0,1),[-0.05,0.05]) from default_rng(seed); no nonlinear inversion or oracle pose score
settings.truth_boundary: truth seeds used only for evaluating predeclared subsets; no truth tangent enters any decision
settings.claim_boundary: tangent-level physical acquisition diagnostic on one reference and two truth states; no nonlinear reconstruction, no method-superiority or universal frame-count claim
